Cadastral map showing landownership in Fushimi, Kyoto. Relief shown pictorially. Title will be "Fushimi jōka ezu" inferred from OPAC https://kochizu.gsi.go.jp/items/156, Nov. 25, 2020. Date, scale, and authorship of the map are not indicated. The map was most likely made between 1595 and 1598 before the Uji River was made into Lake. Incomplete legend data: color codes lacking explanation. Red indicates castle, blue means water or river; yellow indicates street; and green means grass or trees. Includes text and col. ill.
